- Unworthiness

- brāhmaṇaka (contemptible brahmin)
- muṇḍaka (contemptible shaven one)
- paṇḍitaka (contemptible/pseudo wise person)

[From uddissa anuññātaṃ odissaṃ, vasānāmena odissaṃ vaso dissaṃ]
Reference: Vi.Ṭha.2.295, Ma U.Sya
This refers to medicinal oil that is explicitly allowed or permitted for use by the Buddha in the Vinaya rules. The term specifically relates to clear oil (vasā) that has been formally sanctioned for medicinal use by Buddhist monastics.
Note: This is a technical term from the Vinaya Piṭaka relating to allowable medicines (bhesajja) for Buddhist monks and nuns.
